set.body:
Purpose and scope
Add the reference interpreter and application entry point for explicit publication. Reuse DerivativeSubmissions collection and ordinary preparation/acceptance. Check completed receipt and retained blobs, current source/private-bundle authority, owner and destination powers; publication must not require the old execution destination to remain writable. Do not launch a producer or mutate its run record.

Acceptance proof
Shared lifecycle tests demonstrate a stale original base followed by intentional publication against an inspected newer base, publication to a separate permitted dataset, retained output reuse after workspace removal, idempotent resume, unchanged run evidence and rejection of unauthorized or incomplete runs. No process execution occurs during publication.

Start here
modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/{DerivativeSubmissions,ReferenceCatalog,Capabilities}.scala; modules/app/src/test/scala/sanctity/app/ProcessingSuite.scala

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: P2: Implement reference-catalog publication intents and retained-output collection
